scope: A3/P2 D141j independent source visibility review

findings.title: Read-head continuity is sourced from the collector's first cached read
findings.effect: After a later accepted read, activeCanonicalOccurrences can be from the later composition while the active event still reports the first accepted head. The checker can therefore accept stale-head continuity across repeat reads/renders.
findings.required_resolution: Retain an identity that is actually correlated from each accepted read through activeCanonicalOccurrences/useShotGroups to the overlay boundary, and exercise a repeat accepted read/render in source control.
